directive: Two additional operants - and + supplement five existing color operants; total 7. Model signed paired root transfer, do not add any color/element address.

semantics.description: Release one symbolic receipt unit from source root at a valid gate
Accept one symbolic receipt unit at the immediately adjacent destination root

signModel.conservationScope: Only the integer bookkeeping unit -1+1=0; not conservation of physical energy, mass, particles, light, hue, or chemistry
signModel.withinRoot: No +/- transfers inside a 122-address root; only H122→O123 and O244→N245
signModel.lid: At N366, no debit and no credit may occur; the only legitimate result is CLOSED with no signed marks
signModel.signedVsCryptographic: The +/- glyphs are ledger bookkeeping signs, not signatures or authentication; all inputs originate from the same simulator.

operands.operatorsDifferentKinds: Five existing actions transform HSV display; the two added signed actions balance transfer receipts. This is NOT seven commutative HSV adjustments.

antiReplay.attemptId: per-transfer caller-supplied opaque identifier; uniqueness required within a local immutable ledger
antiReplay.transferKey: canonical attempt + from + to + strength + ordered program + source identity and gate identifier
antiReplay.ledger: immutable snapshots; reject duplicate attempt ID regardless of changed gate/strength/program
antiReplay.atomicity: A complete and ordered valid -+ pair is required before ledger totals update; partial or corrupted transfer changes no ledger state
antiReplay.threatModel: Deterministic schema integrity and anti-replay only; a fully forged internally consistent fresh input remains possible without independent cryptographic trust anchors.

plannedCampaign.tampering: Reusable corruptions injected into signed receipt event list; each rejected without mutation
plannedCampaign.retainedPriorBehavior: v9.5 native destination color rebasing and hue-jump reporting unchanged

caveats: H, O, N and their atomic numbers are real; the 122-address blocks are symbolic registry ranges.
The sign pair implements balanced integer accounting for a software transfer; it is not physical conservation and does not transform chemical elements.
Signed glyphs are not digital signatures, cryptographic authorization or independent witnesses.
A fresh well-formed forged frame cannot be authenticated without external signatures, protected hardware, or a trusted witness.
Existing five color operant definitions and v9.5 source remain frozen; use additive v9.6 only.
